title: Data Preprocessing Basics: Preparing Your Dataset for Machine Learning

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome to Part One, Data Pre-Processing.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到第一部分：資料前處理。

cues.en: So I had to start with this part because this is a crucial step in the journey of making a machine learning model.
cues.zh: 必須先從這裡開始，因為這是建立機器學習模型過程中的關鍵步驟。

cues.en: If there is no data pre-processing, your machine learning model won't work properly.
cues.zh: 如果沒有資料前處理，模型就無法正常運作。

cues.en: So, you know, it's like preparing a journey.
cues.zh: 就像出發旅行前的準備。

cues.en: Imagine you are about to go for a long journey.
cues.zh: 想像你正要展開一趟長途旅程。

cues.en: Well, you have to prepare your itinerary, book your flights, book your hotels, and pack your luggage.
cues.zh: 必須先規劃行程、訂機票、訂飯店，還要收拾行李。

cues.en: That's definitely the boring part before the trip.
cues.zh: 這絕對是旅行前比較無聊的部分。

cues.en: But then when everything is well prepared and you're ready to go, your trip might be amazing.
cues.zh: 但一切準備就緒、可以出發後，旅程可能非常精彩。

cues.en: Well, it's the same for our machine learning journey.
cues.zh: 機器學習的旅程也是一樣。

cues.en: We have to prepare some stuff in order to make sure that we build our machine learning models without any issues.
cues.zh: 必須先準備好一些事情，才能確保建立模型時不會遇到問題。

cues.en: And the stuff that we need to prepare for our machine learning trip happens to be data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 而這些準備工作，就是資料前處理。

cues.en: So I have to be honest with you, this is the boring part, but we are only doing this so that we get the maximum fun later in this course when we make all the machine learning models.
cues.zh: 坦白說，這部分比較無聊，但目的就是讓後面建立各種模型時，能得到最大的樂趣。

cues.en: So trust me, we have to do it because if we don't do it, we will miss out on all the fun of machine learning.
cues.zh: 相信我，這是必須的，否則就會錯過機器學習的精彩之處。

cues.en: So I did the best I could to gather in this part all the essentials of data precessing, and even if I make sure to make it as simple as possible, there is all you need to know about data pre processing.
cues.zh: 我已盡可能把資料前處理的要點集中在這一部分，並設法講得簡單，同時保留所有必要知識。

cues.en: There is all you need to know how to do to prepare any data set for any machine learning model.
cues.zh: 也就是替各種機器學習模型準備資料集時，你需要知道的全部基本操作。

cues.en: So excluding this one, there are gonna be eight tutorials in this part.
cues.zh: 除了這堂以外，這部分還有八堂教學。

cues.en: So hold on to them and I promise you that we will get a lot of fun once we start our machine learning journey.
cues.zh: 請耐心完成，我保證，正式開始機器學習旅程後，我們會有很多樂趣。
